resources.name: Bonded / Black Blade
resources.description: Record the bonded one-handed piercing or slashing weapon. At 3rd level it advances as a Magus black blade, using Arcanist level and the Arcane Reservoir.

power_providers.label: Blade Adept Magus Arcana
power_providers.description: A retained Arcanist exploit slot may contain one of these five Magus arcana. It uses Arcane Reservoir in place of Arcane Pool; do not fill both this and the corresponding exploit slot.

choice_providers.label: Bloodline
choice_providers.description: Choose one Sorcerer bloodline. The Blood Arcanist gains its arcana and powers, but not its class skill, bonus feats, or bonus spells.

choice_providers.label: Elemental Focus
choice_providers.description: Choose the element that controls bonus preparation, opposition, granted exploits, and Elemental Movement.

fixed_options.name: Air
fixed_options.description: Opposes earth; grants Lightning Lance, Dancing Electricity, and fly 90 feet at 15th level.

fixed_options.name: Earth
fixed_options.description: Opposes air; grants Acid Jet, Lingering Acid, and burrow 30 feet at 15th level.

fixed_options.name: Fire
fixed_options.description: Opposes water; grants Flame Arc, Burning Flame, and +30 feet land speed at 15th level.

fixed_options.name: Water
fixed_options.description: Opposes fire; grants Ice Missile, Icy Tomb, and swim 60 feet at 15th level.

choice_providers.label: School Focus
choice_providers.description: Choose one Wizard school or subschool. Its school powers use Arcanist level, and one additional prepared spell of each spell level must come from that school.

entries.choice_handling_note: The first exploit is fixed to Arcane Barrier; no free persistent choice remains at 1st level.

resources.name: Judgment
resources.description: Judgment uses as an Inquisitor three levels lower. A second simultaneous judgment unlocks at Investigator 11 and a third at 19.

entries.choice_handling_note: Ready for the Revelation is an initiative progression, not an Oracle Revelation choice.

resources.name: Luck
resources.description: The shared heroic pool begins each day at Charisma modifier (minimum 1), is spent on Sleuth deeds, and follows the shared grit/luck/panache recovery rules.

power_providers.label: Ki Powers in Investigator Talent Slots
power_providers.description: Beginning at 5th level, an Investigator Talent slot may instead contain an Unchained Monk ki power. Intelligence replaces Wisdom and Inspiration pays its ki cost; do not fill both representations of the same slot.

resources.name: Armor Training Rank
resources.description: Armor Training begins at 3rd level and improves at 8th, 13th, and 18th level. Its maximum-Dex and armor-check effects are shown with equipped armor.

choice_providers.label: Bloodrager Bloodline
choice_providers.description: Choose the Bloodrager bloodline that grants bloodline powers and the listed bonus spells.

power_providers.label: Hexcrafter Hexes
power_providers.description: Gain one Witch hex at 4th level; later Magus Arcana slots may instead contain a hex. Major hexes unlock at 12th level. Do not fill both a hex and Magus Arcana for the same later slot.

resources.name: Animal Aspect
resources.description: Spend 1 Arcane Pool point to gain one Beast Shape I ability of the animal represented by the current mask for 1 minute per Magus level.

resources.name: Selected Weapon Group Applies
resources.description: Toggle when the attack belongs to a selected weapon group. The bonus is +1 at 6th level and improves at 12th and 18th.

resources.name: Armor Training Rank
resources.description: Armor Training 1 at 8th level and Armor Training 2 at 14th level.

resources.name: Bonded Shield
resources.description: Record the bonded non-tower shield. Arcane Pool may enhance the weapon and shield separately.

resources.name: Bonded Weapon
resources.description: Record the bonded weapon used by Soul Forger Spell Combat, Spellstrike, Fortify Bond, Reforge, and later bond features.

resources.name: Spell Dance
resources.description: Spend 1 Arcane Pool point to activate Spell Dance for 1 minute. Its movement bonus and dodge bonus against movement-triggered attacks of opportunity improve every four levels.
